changes: Made Class ID optional when creating or editing a class; duplicate checks still apply when an ID is entered.
Added structured Course/Program, Year Level, and Section fields to class creation and class editing, with editable suggestions and support for custom entries.

Extended student directory and student account records with an optional Section field; administrators can edit section alongside program and year level, with Section A used as the default for new class-only records.
Preserved existing student enrollments and grade records while introducing structured class cohort metadata.
Moved the former sidebar menu into a responsive top navigation bar, with an active-period My Classes dropdown and mobile-friendly navigation controls.
Enhanced the public read-only demo with a local Class Chats simulation so visitors can explore chat workflows without connecting to live Google Chat.
Enabled tenant managers to edit class-only student records, including student program and year details.
Moved grading-sheet signatory names and positions into individual teacher profiles, with validation before export and a backfill for existing teacher accounts.
Added Google Chat integration for class Spaces, including secure teacher account linking, student membership invitations and roster synchronization, and teacher announcements.
Introduced the Class Chats hub for teachers and students, with role-scoped class Spaces, invitation and membership status, and direct links to Google Chat.
Added school workspace administration, invitations, manual invoicing, billing reminders, and an improved tenant management interface.
Added an activity chooser, read-only resources, student class activities, and topic filters for the question bank.
Added teacher-posted Drive activities, scheduled openings, and quizzes with optional question-bank reuse.
Added class activities, a question bank and auto-graded quizzes, assignment submissions, and linked class record scores.
Reflect saved tenant tier changes immediately and show the current plan and its limits in Tenant Management.
Validate assessment dates and category item weights before saving, and reject duplicate assessment or category IDs and malformed score requests.
Keep the student name visible on narrow screens while allowing the attendance summary and meeting columns to scroll.
Limit the display of student IDs to authorized rosters. Remove IDs from attendance alerts, scorebook screens, student lookup results, grade previews, profiles, and Quick Grade Check results.
Use the same attendance cutoff in Class Attendance and Teacher Overview, and refresh the overview after attendance changes so early warnings stay out of the dashboard.

Added attendance risk alerts with absence dates, consecutive absence streaks, and automatic treatment of every third consecutive late as absent. Teacher Overview highlights high-risk attendance and danger of failing. Class Attendance shows early and dropping warnings.
Replaced the separate Test the Software imitation with one-click guest access to SAGA's actual Teacher and Student pages.
Created a dedicated fictional college, class roster, assessments and grade records for the authentic read-only demo.
Demo sessions expire in 45 minutes and cannot modify any SAGA API; school and account permissions remain enforced.
Retained the original editable sample simulator under a clearly labeled optional Practice Simulator page.
Kept the demo school hidden from regular registration and added security regression checks. No Dean role was introduced.
Launched a public interactive Test the Software tour featuring Teacher, Student, and read-only Platform Administrator previews.
Teacher demo includes editable gradebook scores, attendance, grade visibility, and simulated submission states using fictional records.
Student demo includes sample grades and an isolated what-if score simulator; switching roles retains in-browser sample changes until reset.
Public demo data never invokes production authentication, grades, tenant management APIs, or Neon database writes.
Added responsive light and dark demo palettes, accessible navigation controls, and a landing-page entry point.
Teachers can now search and add registered, email-verified students from their own school directly to a class roster.
Teachers can generate, copy, rotate, or revoke seven-day class invitation codes for verified students.
Students can join an eligible class from their Student Portal using a teacher-provided invitation code and view their linked class list.
Enrollment now preserves existing attendance, assessment scores, and grade history when linking registered students to existing class records.
Added duplicate-enrollment, tenant-isolation, account-verification, and invitation-code protections.
The global copyright footer now follows the saved Light/Dark appearance setting on all portal and administration pages.
Teachers now have a calm navy-and-blue interface with warm highlights; students have a welcoming teal-and-sky palette, each with dark-mode alternatives.
Improved contrast for navigation, grade-summary cards, controls, and account preferences without changing academic status colors.
The footer stays aligned with the class sidebar on desktop, adapts to mobile screens, and remains hidden from printed grade reports.
Added a consistent copyright and release-version footer across SAGA, including a link to this version history.
Improved My Classes navigation: desktop hover opens the menu, while mobile uses tap-to-expand without selecting a class.
Added Student ID or email sign-in for registered students and Faculty IDs for teacher registration and profiles.
Added existing-school selection and a Not listed option to teacher signup.
Expanded Tenant Operations with school health, subscription follow-ups, verification totals, activity and payment reporting.
Improved student grade summaries, on-demand assessment details, grade simulation navigation and mobile layouts.
Optimized class records, workbook score saving, roster imports and attendance completion checks.
